name: Human tonsil, imaging mass cytometry
description: Hyperion imaging mass cytometry of a human tonsil section with 27 metal-tagged antibodies, as OME-Zarr; opens on CD3 (T cells), CD19 (B cells), and CD68 (macrophages).

source.citation: Durand M et al. (2019) Human lymphoid organ cDC2 and macrophages play complementary roles in T follicular helper responses. J Exp Med 216(7):1561-1581. doi:10.1084/jem.20181994
